findings: Zod v4 can produce JSON Schema from the caller-facing schema including placement fields.
Structured result JSON already exists for both success and failure paths.
Preview images currently travel as base64 image content, outside structuredContent.
Capability and resolver caches are in-memory only and will be lost after one-shot CLI exit.
MEDIA_EDITOR_DATA_DIR already anchors setup installs, resolver lookup, and health output.
